characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During this model’s attack action if any dice rolled is an unmodified 10 that dice is considered a critical hit, critical hits do an additional +1 damage. E. g. if a model with a blade (Damage 1 / 3) scores a glance (1 damage),a hit (3 damage) and a critical hit (3+1 damage)that attack action would do 8 damage.
